product.title: Fetele disparute din Paris
product.description: Într-o dimineață, în timp ce trece prin Gara Grand Central pe drumul spre serviciu, Grace Healey găsește o valiză abandonată ascunsă sub o bancă. Învinsă de propria curiozitate, Grace deschide valiza, în care descoperă o duzină de fotografii – fiecare a altei femei. Într-un moment de impulsivitate, Grace ia fotografiile și părăsește imediat gara. Află curând că valiza îi aparține unei femei pe nume Eleanor Trigg, lidera unei rețele de agente secrete din Londra, în timpul celui de-al Doilea Război Mondial. Douăsprezece dintre aceste femei au fost trimise în Europa ocupată ca operatoare de radio și curieri pentru a ajuta Rezistența, dar nu s-au mai întors niciodată acasă, iar destinul lor rămâne un mister. Încercând să afle adevărul despre femeile din fotografii, atenția lui Grace este atrasă de o tânără mamă devenită agent, Marie, a cărei misiune îndrăzneață de peste mări îi dezvăluie o remarcabilă poveste despre prietenie, vitejie și trădare. „În Fetele dispărute din Paris, Pam Jenoff își folosește exemplar abilitățile de scriitoare și produce o poveste cu spioni, inteligentă, plină de suspans și cu o morală complicată, dar foarte modernă. Eleanor Trigg și fetele ei sunt pe cât de umane, pe atât de curajoase. Nu am putut s-o las din mână.“ Jessica Shattuck, autoarea romanului Văduvele de la castel

# The Girls Lost in Paris (Fetele disparute din Paris) by Litera

## A Gripping Mystery of Friendship, Courage, and War

Step back into a thrilling world of espionage and mystery with **The Girls Lost in Paris** (*Fetele disparute din Paris*), a captivating novel from the brand Litera. This story masterfully blends elements of historical fiction, suspense, and deep human connection, making it an unmissable read for fans of WWII and secret history.

### Plot Summary: Discovery in Grand Central Station

The narrative begins with Grace Healey's routine day passing through Grand Central Station when she stumbles upon a seemingly abandoned suitcase hidden beneath a bench. Driven by curiosity, she opens the case and discovers a dozen photographsâeach belonging to a different woman.

These pictures lead her on an unexpected journey as she learns that the suitcase belongs to Eleanor Trigg, leader of an extraordinary network of secret agents operating out of London during World War II. Twelve women were dispatched across occupied Europe, serving as radio operators and couriers to aid the Resistanceâwomen whose fates remained shrouded in mystery.

As Grace attempts to unravel the truth behind these missing women, her attention falls upon Marie, a young mother who has become an agent herself. Marie's daring mission across borders reveals a remarkable story of friendship, bravery, and betrayal. Pam Jenoff delivers a spy novel that is intelligent, suspenseful, deeply emotional, yet wonderfully modern in its moral complexities.

> *"In Fetele disparute din Paris, Pam Jenoff uses her writing skills to produce a spy story with intelligence, suspense, and complex morals, but very modern. Eleanor Trigg and her girls are as human as they are courageous. I couldn't put it down."* â Jessica Shattuck, author of *The Daughters of the Castle*.

### Why You Will Love This Novel

If you enjoy historical fiction that combines fast-paced action with profound character development, this book is for you. **The Girls Lost in Paris** offers:

*   **Intrigue:** A compelling mystery set against the backdrop of wartime Europe.
*   **Strong Characters:** Deeply human and incredibly courageous portrayals of women who defied history.
*   **Suspenseful Plot:** A journey of discovery that keeps you turning pages until the final chapter.

Don't miss this incredible tale of resistance, sacrifice, and enduring friendship.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this a historical mystery or a contemporary story?**
A: The plot is set during the Second World War, making it a historical mystery. However, the narrative structure and themes feel modern, connecting historical events with contemporary characters like Grace Healey.

**Q: Who is the main character I will follow?**
A: While the story revolves around discovering the fates of multiple women agents (like Eleanor Trigg), the central perspective follows Grace Healey as she pieces together the mystery.
